verdict.rationale: Muse's architecture explicitly gives the agent its own separate computer (VM) with file system/terminal to write code and build tools, rather than seeing/operating applications on the user's own computer/desktop; no evidence describes screen control or app automation on the user's actual device. missing for 10: any first-party or hands-on evidence of Muse operating applications on the user's own machine/screen (e.g., clicking, navigating, or controlling local apps), independent verification of such control.
